name: Matjaž Nemec-After § 8-Am 14
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2026
part_text: 8a. Recalls that a bombshell report revealed the Commission's brazen misuse of taxpayer funds, funnelling billions into a shadowy network of NGOs and think tanks to promote its own political agenda and silence dissenting voices; condemns this enormous EU-NGO propaganda complex, that undermines democracy and constitutes a massive betrayal of Union citizens; requests that Parliament's communication spending be thoroughly scrutinised in this regard;
